from pathlib import Path

import sys

from scripts import scheduler_evidence as owner
root=Path.cwd();assert Path(owner.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(root)
ev=Path(r'C:/Users/86177/AppData/Local/Temp/sbq123-final-readiness-evidence-20260910')
observed=[]
def fake_ssh(argv,**kwargs):
 observed.append(argv)
 return subprocess.CompletedProcess(argv,1,'','simulated transport end')
with patch.object(owner.subprocess,'run',fake_ssh):
 try: owner.query_lsf_job('123; bkill 456 #')
 except RuntimeError: pass
assert len(observed)==1
argv=observed[0];assert argv[0]=='ssh'
# OpenSSH joins remote argv with spaces. Only Bash functions exist in this local
# reproduction; neither ssh, bjobs nor bkill executables are called.
command=' '.join(argv[2:])
script='bjobs() { printf "FAKE_QUERY\\n"; }; bkill() { printf "FAKE_MUTATION:%s\\n" "$*"; }; '+command
r=subprocess.run(['C:/Program Files/Git/bin/bash.exe','--noprofile','--norc','-c',script],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=10)
assert 'FAKE_MUTATION:456' in r.stdout,(r.returncode,r.stdout,r.stderr)
result=dict(id='FINAL-B1-001',severity='P1',source='scripts/scheduler_evidence.py:30',transport_argv=argv,joined_remote_command=command,simulation_stdout=r.stdout,simulation_exit=r.returncode,gate_calls=0,real_ssh_calls=0,external_scientific_actions=0,mechanism='Unvalidated job_id reaches SSH remote-shell command; local shell=False does not quote the remote argv. Validation after subprocess cannot prevent dispatch.')
(ev/'scheduler_injection_probe.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2),encoding='utf-8');print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))

import sys,pathlib,subprocess,json,os
root=pathlib.Path.cwd();sys.path.insert(0,str(root));sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'tests'))
from test_thickness_workflow_safety import Payload
assert pathlib.Path(sys.modules['scripts.convergence.setup_true_fe110_thickness_retest'].__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(root)
ev=pathlib.Path(r'C:/Users/86177/AppData/Local/Temp/sbq123-final-readiness-evidence-20260910');py=ev/'release/wheel-venv/Scripts/python.exe'
env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if k not in {'PYTHONPATH','PYTHONHOME'}}
probe=subprocess.run([str(py),'-c','import scripts.convergence.thickness_stage as m; print(m.__file__)'],cwd=ev/'release/outside',env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,check=True)
assert str(ev/'release/wheel-venv').lower().replace('\\','/') in probe.stdout.lower().replace('\\','/')
results=[]
for kind,mode,expected,count in [('chain','valid',0,2),('static','valid',0,1),('chain','exit9',9,1),('static','exit9',9,1),('chain','old',65,0),('static','missing',65,1)]:
 p=Payload(ev/('installed-'+kind+'-'+mode),kind);p.env.pop('PYTHONPATH',None);p.env.pop('PYTHONHOME',None);p.env['THICKNESS_PYTHON']=py.as_posix()
 if mode=='old':(p.stages[0]/'OUTCAR').write_text('retained old output')
 else:p.env['FAKE_'+('RELAX' if kind=='chain' else 'STATIC')]=mode
 r=p.run();assert r.returncode==expected,(kind,mode,r.returncode,r.stderr);assert len(p.calls())==count
 record=p.record();assert 'scientific_acceptance=false' in record
 results.append(dict(kind=kind,mode=mode,exit=r.returncode,fake_calls=len(p.calls()),record=record.strip()))
 print(kind,mode,r.returncode,count,flush=True)
(ev/'installed_payload.json').write_text(json.dumps({'helper_origin':probe.stdout.strip(),'results':results,'external_actions':0},indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
